Experienced data analyst focused on retail and enterprise analytics, delivering dashboards, ETL automation, and ad-hoc analysis using SQL, Python and Power BI.

Data Analyst, Zentrix Labs
Oct 2024 - May 2026
Built and maintained Power BI dashboards for sales and inventory KPIs, reducing monthly report generation time by 70% using Python scripts and SQL-based ETL. Developed automated Excel templates and macros for data validation that cut reconciliation time by 50%. Implemented data quality checks in Python (pandas) and scheduled Linux-based scripts to refresh data pipelines. Collaborated with product and ops teams via Jira to track 25+ analytic feature requests.

Data Analyst, Cognizant
Mar 2024 - Sep 2024
Owned weekly and monthly performance reports using Microsoft Excel and SQL, improving reporting accuracy and slashing manual effort through Python-driven data preprocessing. Created interactive Excel models for stakeholder scenarios and supported migration of key reports into Power BI prototypes. Logged and managed tasks and defects in Jira.

Data Analyst, Quanta Retail
May 2022 - Feb 2024
Designed Power BI retail dashboards showing store-level sales, promotions lift and inventory turnover; dashboards informed pricing and assortment decisions that improved gross margin by estimated 2-3% at pilot stores. Wrote Python (pandas) scripts to transform POS and loyalty data and optimized SQL queries for faster aggregate calculations. Performed ad-hoc analysis and exported validated datasets to Excel for finance reviews.

Skills: SQL, Python, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, pandas, Jira, Linux

Education: MBA (Finance), NMIMS
